name: silu_and_mul_masked
description: Masked gated SiLU for grouped experts. input is [E, T, H] with even H; for expert e and token t < masked_m[e], out[e,t,:] = cast(gate * sigmoid(gate) * up, input.dtype), where gate = input[e,t,:H/2] and up = input[e,t,H/2:]. Only rows t < masked_m[e] are part of the contract and are the only rows compared by the suites; the reference zero-initializes rows beyond the mask, while the native kernel does not write them. Returns a newly allocated [E, T, H/2] tensor and does not mutate input. masked_m is an int32 per-expert count. Suites exercise bfloat16 input and int32 masked_m, including zero-count experts.
